components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id

          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"

          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'

          example: Madison
        telephone:

          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'

      required:

## Summary

The change rejects owner creation when any of `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, or `telephone` is missing or blank, returning **400** with a JSON body whose `errors` array lists the offending field names.

The app validates `OwnerFieldsDto` via OpenAPI-generated Bean Validation (`@Valid` on the `addOwner` request body), so failures already surface as `MethodArgumentNotValidException` handled by `ExceptionControllerAdvice`. I made two edits:

1. **`ExceptionControllerAdvice.java`** — In the `MethodArgumentNotValidException` handler, added an `errors` property to the `ProblemDetail` containing the distinct field names of every validation error (`FieldError::getField`), defaulting to an empty list. This produces the required top-level `$.errors` array (e.g. `["city"]`).

2. **`openapi.yml`** — Added `pattern: '.*\S.*'` to `address` and `city`. These two fields previously only had `minLength: 1`, so whitespace-only values (e.g. `"   "`) passed validation. The pattern requires at least one non-whitespace character, closing the "blank" gap for them — consistent with how `firstName`/`lastName`/`telephone` already use patterns. Missing (`null`) values are still caught by the generated `@NotNull`.

Together these ensure every missing-or-blank case among the five fields is rejected with 400 and reported by name in `errors`, while a fully valid owner is still created (2xx). Verified: `Tests run: 3, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` — BUILD SUCCESS.

Note: the change edits `src/main/resources/openapi.yml`, from which the `OwnerFieldsDto`/API interfaces are regenerated during the build, so no generated source needs to be committed manually.
